cover.name: Two silhouettes at river bend
cover.alt: The towers and cables of Vidyasagar Setu rise in silhouette against a golden sunset at Kolkata’s Princep Ghat.

frames.name: Two silhouettes at river bend
frames.alt: The towers and cables of Vidyasagar Setu rise in silhouette against a golden sunset at Kolkata’s Princep Ghat.

frames.name: A narrow band of dawn
frames.alt: The steel bridge enters from the right above still water, leaving a small opening for the pale sun and its broken reflection.

frames.name: A boat under orange sky
frames.alt: The bridge recedes into evening blue while a low boat crosses the glowing river, its wake pulling a thin line through the reflections.

frames.name: Last light over the water
frames.alt: A narrow boat travels beneath a streaked orange horizon, its dark outline separating the bright band of clouded sky from the broad river.

frames.name: Bridge above the river crowd
frames.alt: Blue hour settles over the bridge while blurred visitors gather along the bank, their movement softened against the crisp lights and dark water.

frames.name: Riverbank beneath a blue bridge
frames.alt: The steel bridge’s cables cut into the blue dusk above scattered riverside figures, with a strip of orange light mirrored on the water.

frames.name: Evening beneath the riverside bridge
frames.alt: The cable bridge cuts across the blue dusk above the dark river, its warm lamps and long reflections gathering near the far bank.

frames.name: Bridge cables over evening water
frames.alt: The cable bridge cuts diagonally across the blue river, its illuminated span mirrored in broken streaks below as the darkening sky gathers overhead.

cover.name: Seller at closed shutter
cover.alt: Two women browse colourful accessories at a market stall in front of a closed metal shutter.

frames.name: Seller at closed shutter
frames.alt: Two women browse colourful accessories at a market stall in front of a closed metal shutter.

frames.name: Behind the crowded counter
frames.alt: A seated vendor looks out from shelves of sweets and small goods, framed by a shopper’s blue shoulder and bright packets overhead.

frames.name: Rickshaw traffic at Esplanade
frames.alt: A seated passenger rides past shopfronts as a man walks beside the handcart, with stacked goods and striped awnings crowding the street.

frames.name: Seller and his toys
frames.alt: A shopkeeper leans over plush toys as a child reaches in; red hearts and crowded shelves turn the stall into a scene.

frames.name: Vendor at his stall
frames.alt: The shopkeeper sits beneath a dark signboard, his face picked out among hanging packets and stacked containers in the narrow stall doorway.

frames.name: Faces between market stalls
frames.alt: A woman in a black veil meets the camera among several shoppers, the faces and patterned shawls filling the crowded street view.

frames.name: Faces in silver tones
frames.alt: Several women turn toward the camera, their faces and patterned shawls layered tightly against the darkened market backdrop under the shop awning.

frames.name: Serving from food counter
frames.alt: A seated vendor reaches across bowls of snacks while a customer waits nearby; warm bulbs illuminate the close, busy stall, at work.

cover.name: Vendors gathered around the market goods
cover.alt: Several men lean over a market table, sorting items while their checked shirts and close shoulders form a busy cluster.

frames.name: Vendors gathered around the market goods
frames.alt: Several men lean over a market table, sorting items while their checked shirts and close shoulders form a busy cluster.

frames.name: Gathering green leaves from the stall
frames.alt: A woman reaches into a pile of greens, her red sari arcing across the frame above the bed of leaves.

frames.name: A pause at the fruit stall
frames.alt: The vendor waits behind his counter as a woman passes in profile; hanging pictures and stacked produce gather around him.

frames.name: Seated shopkeeper in the blue light
frames.alt: An older man sits in the shadowed stall, his turquoise trousers against the quiet clutter and black doorway around him.

frames.name: A dog beside the market entrance
frames.alt: A white dog walks past a seated man and standing vendors beside a metal gate on the paved market lane.

frames.name: Pedestrians crossing beside a city bus
frames.alt: Two pedestrians cross in front of a bus, one carrying a striped shopping bag, with shopfronts and traffic behind them.

frames.name: Two dogs wait with their keepers
frames.alt: A seated man and companion share the pavement with two alert dogs, four figures gathered together against the shaded shopfront.

frames.name: Water work in the market lane
frames.alt: A worker bends over a basin in the wet street, beside buckets, scattered produce and dim market stalls behind him.

cover.name: A sculptor beside model’s face
cover.alt: A bespectacled artisan leans toward the soft clay portrait, his cheek and the unfinished statue’s smooth profile catching the same warm light.

frames.name: A sculptor beside model’s face
frames.alt: A bespectacled artisan leans toward the soft clay portrait, his cheek and the unfinished statue’s smooth profile catching the same warm light.

frames.name: Two workers among unfinished figures
frames.alt: Two workers lean toward a clay figure in the busy studio, surrounded by unfinished statues and carved forms beneath the crowded roof.

frames.name: An idol behind the awning
frames.alt: A painted goddess appears through a narrow workshop opening, her golden face and raised hand catching light among beams and unfinished forms.

frames.name: Hands among unfinished clay figures
frames.alt: Several clay arms reach inward around a small sculpted face, creating a crowded workshop view where one bright eye holds the centre.

frames.name: Face behind glass and paint
frames.alt: The goddess’s gold face emerges through reflective decoration; tiny beads and dark folds gather around her wide eyes beside an ornate crown.

frames.name: Clay arms in dark room
frames.alt: Unfinished figures crowd around the worker’s steady raised hand, their pale clay surfaces emerging from shadow in a close, high-contrast workshop frame.

frames.name: A goddess in painted light
frames.alt: A richly coloured Durga face looks out from the pandal wall, framed by painted figures and warm spots of reflected light inside.

frames.name: Small figures in idol room
frames.alt: Rows of unfinished clay bodies crowd the workshop; a few workers thread between them, their forms turning the room into a pattern.

cover.name: Waterfall through the green forest
cover.alt: A waterfall pours down a rocky slope through dense greenery, with branches framing the white stream against the dark hillside.

frames.name: Waterfall through the green forest
frames.alt: A waterfall pours down a rocky slope through dense greenery, with branches framing the white stream against the dark hillside.

frames.name: Clouds above Gangtok’s green hillside
frames.alt: The monochrome view layers a dense hillside settlement beneath distant ridges, while a heavy cloud breaks open above the valley.

frames.name: The Milky Way above black rock
frames.alt: A dense sweep of stars rises above the jagged ridge, with the mountain silhouette keeping the galactic band in the frame.

frames.name: Homes climbing the wet slope
frames.alt: A tree rises above clustered roofs on the hillside, its dark branches separating the foreground houses from layered clouded mountains.

frames.name: A hillside town
frames.alt: Colourful homes cling to the steep hillside beneath soft cloud, while the green valley fades toward a blue-grey mountain line.

frames.name: Gangtok scattered across the dark
frames.alt: A hillside town glitters against the night, each cluster of lights tracing the slope beneath the deep, nearly black sky.

frames.name: A tree among hillside roofs
frames.alt: One broad tree rises above the village houses, separating the near green slope from a hazy chain of mountains beyond.

frames.name: The bus through mountain fog
frames.alt: A bus follows the narrow hillside road into drifting mist, with wet rock and dense forest closing around its route.

cover.name: The sun beyond the river trees
cover.alt: Orange light settles over the river as a tree darkens the foreground, the bridge stretching beyond a lone figure at the water’s edge.

frames.name: The sun beyond the river trees
frames.alt: Orange light settles over the river as a tree darkens the foreground, the bridge stretching beyond a lone figure at the water’s edge.

frames.name: One porter beneath Howrah’s iron span
frames.alt: A man balances a broad load overhead as another figure crosses the riverbank; the steel bridge’s lattice fills the cloudy sky behind them.

frames.name: A load carried past the river
frames.alt: A porter steadies a rounded bundle overhead while walking beside the Hooghly; the steel bridge and amber clouds hold the bank in shadow.

frames.name: Along the wide riverbank at midday
frames.alt: A lone woman walks beside the river beneath the immense bridge, her pale clothes set against dark water and the bright open sky.

frames.name: The carrier and the iron bridge
frames.alt: A lone man walks with a covered basket balanced overhead; the steel bridge spans behind him as the low sun warms the riverbank.

frames.name: Two dogs beside the broad river
frames.alt: Two dogs stand near a pair of seated men, with the bridge’s dark trusses stretched across the pale grey river water behind them.

frames.name: A quiet lone walker at sundown
frames.alt: The steel bridge spans the amber river as a small figure steps through the shallows, isolated between the bright horizon and dark city.

frames.name: Two dark silhouettes by the trusses
frames.alt: A pair sits facing the broad river beneath the steel bridge, their dark outlines small against the open monochrome water and low cloud.

cover.name: Pool reflection
cover.alt: The red sandstone tomb appears upside down in the pool, its arches and palms softened by ripples across the foreground water.

frames.name: Pool reflection
frames.alt: The red sandstone tomb appears upside down in the pool, its arches and palms softened by ripples across the foreground water.

frames.name: Red symmetry
frames.alt: Humayun’s Tomb stands square to the camera, its red arches set against a sky and a narrow strip of green lawn.

frames.name: Shaded gateway
frames.alt: In monochrome, the garden gate frames a smaller arch beyond it; branches and deep shade enclose the path to the tomb.

frames.name: Inverted arches
frames.alt: A pool reflects the sandstone arches upside down, its still waterline cutting the building cleanly across the middle of the frame.

frames.name: Courtyard visitors
frames.alt: People cross the open path before the red tomb’s central gateway, their small silhouettes bringing scale to the heavy stone entrance.

frames.name: Garden geometry
frames.alt: Humayun’s Tomb rests beyond a broad green lawn, with palms and a spreading shade tree breaking the building’s long red façade.

frames.name: Passing blur
frames.alt: A moving figure crosses the shadowed foreground while the bright tomb remains sharp beyond the gate, setting motion against still stone.

frames.name: Palm façade
frames.alt: A palm and leafy tree partly screen Humayun’s Tomb, its dome and long red façade set beneath a clear pastel sky.
